tasks.short: Prepare routine legal documents and correspondence, obtain approval, and maintain the matter file.

steps.what: Read instructions and collect supporting documents.

loop.output: Document request with source-linked fields and missing information.
loop.check: Validate required fields; show each extracted fact beside its source.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass; unresolved fields go to the paralegal.
loop.why_not_simpler: An intake form handles structured requests; existing narrative instructions still require reading.

steps.what: Check names, dates, matter references, and missing facts.
Populate a precedent and draft case-specific wording.

loop.input: Verified facts, approved precedent, and selected source passages.
loop.output: Routine document draft with factual source references.
loop.check: Lock standard wording; validate populated fields; flag unsupported statements.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; missing evidence produces a placeholder.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle standard wording; case-specific narrative cannot always be expressed as field substitutions.

steps.what: Review legal wording and decide whether the document is ready.
Resolve factual corrections with the declarant or business contact.
Obtain release approval and send correspondence or arrange execution.
Name, index, and file the final document and receipt.

tasks.design: Configure matter metadata, precedents, versioning, and filing in the {DOCS}, with requests and release approvals in the {WORKFLOW}. A bounded loop extracts narrative instructions and drafts variable passages; deterministic checks validate fields before approved dispatch through the {EMAIL} or execution through the {ESIGN}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative requests, inconsistent precedents, and disconnected filing made simple mail merges insufficient. Confidentiality and execution requirements also limited reuse.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing templates and approval features cover much of the task. AI-assisted coding can reduce connector development effort; bounded extraction handles the remaining narrative inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Confirming disputed facts, protecting confidentiality, and meeting jurisdiction-specific execution requirements. Electronic signing does not satisfy every affidavit formality.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a declarant is uncertain, a statement overreaches, or routine correspondence carries an unintended legal commitment.

ambition.what: Routine legal correspondence clinic for business teams.

tasks.altitude: The paralegal spends less time copying facts and filing versions, and more time resolving incomplete instructions. They gain delegated authority to return incomplete requests and select approved routine templates; lawyers retain legal release authority.

reach.task: Prepare a first issue list for routine correspondence.
reach.learn: Distinguish factual assertions, legal conclusions, and commitments requiring legal approval.

evidence.claim: Libra and Legora offer legal drafting and review capabilities; this supports capability availability, not unattended release.
Ashurst reported 80% time savings on corporate filings in its trial; that result does not establish savings for affidavits.
Templates, metadata validation, approved dispatch, and automatic filing can handle routine document administration.
GDPR Article 28 requires appropriate processor terms when a processor handles personal data.

assumptions: The baseline is an in-house legal team serving a European company with 200 to 2,000 staff.
Routine documents use reusable precedents; substantive drafting is covered separately.
Step shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured savings.
Build ranges cover one document family; access work may overlap development.
GDPR applies. EU AI Act obligations depend on the actual use; national rules govern execution formalities and employee consultation.
unknowns: Which precedents are approved and who may authorise release?
Which documents require witnesses, notarisation, originals, or physical filing?
Can the existing document store enforce matter access and retention?
Does rollout trigger consultation under applicable national rules?
research_questions: Which document families can be generated entirely from structured intake?
Which execution routes are valid for the selected jurisdictions?
new_work: Review extracted facts and unsupported draft passages.
Maintain precedents, required fields, and recipient rules.
Handle dispatch failures, execution exceptions, and filing conflicts.
Periodically inspect access controls and retention behaviour.

tasks.short: Draft and revise substantive legal documents for lawyer review and authorised release.

steps.what: Clarify the document purpose, jurisdiction, deadline, and legal instructions.
Collect precedents, source documents, and any financial schedules.
Identify factual gaps, clause choices, and departures from the precedent.

loop.input: Drafting pack, approved clause guidance, and drafting brief.
loop.output: Source-linked gaps, deviations, and proposed clause options.
loop.check: Check checklist coverage; require exact passages for every alleged deviation.
loop.stop: One comparison and one repair pass; unresolved legal choices remain open.
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact comparisons handle standard clauses, but negotiated wording can express equivalent or conflicting obligations.

steps.what: Prepare the first draft and calculate schedules where required.

loop.input: Approved precedent, reviewed issue list, and source-linked facts.
loop.output: Legal document draft with marked variable passages and unresolved points.
loop.check: Validate fields, cross-references, and source support; calculate financial schedules deterministically.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unsupported arguments remain flagged for a person.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates and arithmetic cover standard material; bespoke arguments and negotiated clauses require language generation.

steps.what: Check citations, definitions, amounts, cross-references, and consistency.
Resolve legal choices and revise arguments, obligations, or remedies.
Obtain release approval, issue the document, and save the final version.

tasks.design: Use approved precedents in the {DOCS}, structured instructions in the {WORKFLOW}, and controlled financial inputs from the {ERP}. Deterministic generators handle fields, schedules, and cross-references; bounded loops compare clauses and draft variable passages, with lawyer approval before release through the {EMAIL}, {ESIGN}, or {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Legal document types vary widely, and precedent quality is uneven. Conventional assembly tools struggle with negotiated language and case-specific arguments.
tasks.enabler_now: Document assembly and arithmetic already work deterministically. Bounded language models can assist comparison and first drafting, while AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of connecting these parts.
tasks.still_hard: Legal strategy, enforceability, conflicting evidence, and changing law still demand qualified judgement. Mechanical citation matching cannot establish that an authority supports an argument.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing which obligations or arguments serve the matter, and recognising when a plausible draft creates unacceptable exposure.

ambition.what: Pre-negotiation clause options briefing for business owners.

tasks.altitude: The paralegal spends more of the week comparing options and resolving factual gaps. They gain delegated authority to apply approved drafting options within a written playbook; lawyers retain substantive legal decisions and release authority.

reach.task: Prepare a clause options briefing before negotiation.
reach.learn: Explain legal and commercial consequences, precedent limits, and escalation thresholds.

evidence.claim: Legora offers legal drafting and review capabilities.
Ashurst reported 45% time savings on first-draft briefings in its trial; this is not a benchmark for all legal documents.
Document templates and deterministic arithmetic can generate standard clauses, populated fields, and closing schedules.
The digest records a Dutch case involving unchecked AI-drafted pleadings and a full-costs consequence.

assumptions: Most in-house work concerns contracts, correspondence, and dispute drafts; specialist instruments involve qualified external support.
Financial schedules apply only to relevant document types.
Collection automation uses an explicit source manifest and existing permissions.
Portal transmission remains manual where no supported automation exists; the remaining-time estimate includes that work.
Build ranges cover one substantive document family, not every instrument listed in the occupational description.
GDPR applies; EU AI Act classification follows the deployment context. National rules govern professional duties, execution, filing, and consultation.
unknowns: Which document family has sufficient repeat volume and approved precedents?
Which clause decisions can be delegated to a paralegal?
Which financial inputs have an authoritative source?
Which filing channels support controlled submission?
What access, processor terms, and national consultation requirements apply?
research_questions: Which drafting choices can be captured as explicit rules?
How often do precedent deviations require legal escalation?
What quality threshold should a pilot meet before expanding to another document family?
new_work: Review proposed clause classifications and generated passages.
Maintain approved precedents and clause guidance.
Verify legal citations and substantive use of authorities.
Investigate inconsistent calculations and failed submissions.
Revalidate generation rules after precedent changes.

tasks.short: Investigate case facts and legal authorities, then prepare a verified research briefing for a lawyer.

steps.what: Agree the research question, jurisdiction, relevant dates, and factual uncertainties.
Search legal research databases, public registers, and the matter file.
Check source relevance, jurisdiction, authority, and currency.
Extract material facts, dates, holdings, and conflicting evidence.

loop.input: Verified source pack and supporting documents.
loop.output: Fact chronology and authority table with quotations and source locations.
loop.check: Match quotations to source text; mark allegations, findings, and conflicting dates separately.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass per source; unresolved conflicts go to the paralegal.
loop.why_not_simpler: Dates can be parsed by rules, but their meaning and the distinction between allegations and findings require reading.

steps.what: Write a research briefing addressing the question and evidence gaps.

loop.input: Research brief, reviewed chronology, and verified authority passages.
loop.output: Research draft with supported propositions, contrary authority, and open questions.
loop.check: Require source references for legal propositions; block unsupported citations and flag uncertain conclusions.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unresolved citations block delivery as a verified briefing.
loop.why_not_simpler: The briefing must connect facts with varied legal texts; fixed templates only provide its structure.

steps.what: Open cited sources and verify quotations and the propositions they support.
Assess possible causes of action and decide further investigation.

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in the legal research database, represented by the {OTHER}, and keep a source register in the {DOCS}. A controlled answer desk on the {DATA_PLATFORM} extracts chronology and drafts briefings from selected sources, with deterministic citation checks and human verification before a lawyer uses the findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research depends on source licences, changing law, incomplete facts, and context-sensitive relevance. Keyword search alone cannot produce a reliable case briefing.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved searches and source registers already reduce repeated retrieval. Bounded extraction and drafting can turn selected materials into reviewable work, without delegating open-ended investigation.
tasks.still_hard: Finding omitted authorities, establishing whether law remains current, and distinguishing persuasive text from legally relevant support. Source access may require separate licences or unsupported manual retrieval.
tasks.human_edge: Formulating the right question, recognising missing evidence, and testing a preferred theory against contrary facts and authorities.

ambition.what: Early dispute viability briefing before escalation to external counsel.

tasks.altitude: The paralegal spends less time assembling quotations and more time testing evidence gaps. They gain delegated authority to organise the research plan and request factual clarification; lawyers retain legal conclusions and litigation decisions.

reach.task: Prepare a preliminary causes-of-action and evidence-gap matrix.
reach.learn: Map legal elements, limitation issues, burdens of proof, and adverse authority.

evidence.claim: The cited benchmark found errors on over 17% of queries for evaluated legal research tools; this is not a universal tool error rate.
Dutch professional guidance recommends checking citations manually; this is national guidance, not an EU-wide professional rule.
Retrieval logs, exact quotation checks, and source-linked extraction can support a bounded research workflow.

assumptions: The company has recurring disputes or investigations that justify an internal research workflow.
The {OTHER} denotes a licensed legal research database, not an unrestricted web search service.
The baseline includes manual searches and document reading; API access is not assumed.
Integration estimates exclude purchasing source licences and creating unsupported access methods.
GDPR applies to case materials. EU AI Act Annex III assessment depends on purpose; work for courts or ADR bodies needs separate assessment.
National rules govern professional confidentiality and any required employee consultation.
unknowns: Which jurisdictions and source collections must research cover?
What retrieval, storage, and model-processing rights do source licences allow?
Who may certify a briefing as verified?
Are investigations likely to include special-category personal data?
What access controls and consultation steps are required locally?
research_questions: Which source collections expose reliable current-status information?
Can a pilot detect adverse authority and evidence gaps as reliably as the present process?
Which research requests are narrow enough for a fixed source and time budget?
new_work: Maintain source permissions and retrieval connectors.
Verify quotations, legal propositions, and source currency.
Investigate blocked citations and contradictory evidence.
Sample briefings for omitted adverse authority.
Update extraction guidance when recurring classification errors appear.

tasks.short: Prepare trial exhibits, hearing bundles, and logistics with the lawyer.

steps.what: Agree hearing requirements, responsibilities, and the exhibit plan.
Collect requested exhibits and track missing versions or originals.
Map exhibits to issues and propose their sequence.
Number exhibits, paginate files, and create the bundle index.
Review exhibit selection, privilege, redactions, and procedural compliance.
Prepare required paper copies, labels, and original exhibits.
Rehearse exhibit retrieval and resolve hearing logistics with the lawyer.
Obtain release approval and deliver the required bundle.

tasks.design: Configure an exhibit register and missing-item queue in the {DOCS} and {PROJECT}, then generate pagination, bookmarks, and indexes deterministically on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Lawyers retain exhibit and privilege decisions, while the {WORKFLOW} controls release of the exact final bundle through the {EMAIL} or {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Late exhibit changes, variable hearing specifications, and mixed physical and digital evidence made generic bundle assembly unreliable. Judgement-heavy preparation also obscured the separable clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Version control, fixed manifests, document transformation libraries, and configured work queues can automate administration. No model loop is necessary for the proposed first release.
tasks.still_hard: Exhibit relevance, privilege, procedural exceptions, originals, and last-minute strategy changes. Physical preparation and rehearsal remain substantial.
tasks.human_edge: Anticipating what the lawyer will need under pressure, preserving evidence context, and noticing a missing or misleading exhibit.

ambition.what: Pre-hearing evidence-readiness review for external counsel.

tasks.altitude: The paralegal spends less time rebuilding indexes and more time resolving evidence gaps and rehearsing retrieval. They gain delegated authority to enforce bundle specifications and request missing materials; lawyers retain exhibit selection and release decisions.

reach.task: Prepare an issue-to-exhibit gap review before the hearing.
reach.learn: Understand evidential relevance, privilege, authenticity, and procedural requirements.

evidence.claim: Exhibit numbering, pagination, indexing, duplicate detection, and manifest checks can be implemented deterministically.
A work queue can separate missing-item coordination from legal exhibit decisions.
The digest provides no documented trial-bundle case or measured savings for this proposed workflow.

assumptions: The company has occasional litigation, with an internal or external lawyer directing preparation.
This baseline includes some required paper copies or originals; all-digital hearings change the time split.
The source documents are already digitised; conversion of legacy archives is outside the build estimate.
Portal uploads remain manual where supported configuration is unavailable.
The human-heavy prior remains credible for legal selection and rehearsal, while assembly is separately automatable.
GDPR applies. EU AI Act obligations depend on any later model use; national rules govern procedure, evidence handling, and employee consultation.
unknowns: Which hearing venues and bundle specifications recur?
How often are physical copies or original exhibits required?
Who decides privilege, redactions, and final exhibit selection?
What electronic delivery routes and size limits apply?
What local access approval and employee consultation are required?
research_questions: Which recurring bundle specifications can be encoded as validation rules?
Can the generator preserve required signatures, redactions, bookmarks, and document integrity?
Which late changes cause the most assembly rework?
new_work: Maintain bundle specifications and venue checklists.
Resolve duplicate, missing-version, and unreadable-file exceptions.
Verify redactions and inspect generated bundles before release.
Check delivery receipts and manage replacement bundles.
Maintain permissions and retention for hearing materials.

role.altitude: The role moves from document assembly toward evidence quality, drafting options, and hearing readiness. Delegated rights can expand within approved playbooks, while lawyers retain legal strategy, substantive advice, and external release decisions.
reach: Lawyer: prepare clause options and explain escalation points.
Lawyer: map possible causes of action to verified facts and evidence gaps.
Lawyer: prepare an issue-to-exhibit readiness review.
skills_to_grow: Source verification and legal research methods.
Evidence provenance, privilege, and redaction review.
Confidential data handling and access control.
Clear explanation of uncertainty and escalation.
role.ambitious_version: A legal operations and case-preparation specialist who delivers verified drafting packs, early dispute briefings, and hearing-readiness reviews, with explicit delegated authority and lawyer accountability for legal decisions.
